# DISCO fixtures

Retrieved 2026-08-13 from github.com/pruizf/disco (main, v5.0 —
February 2023 release). Three WHOLE real per-author TEI files from
tei/all-periods-per-author/ (the corpus's own complete aggregation:
1,216 author-period files, exact git-tree count 2026-08-13, holding
all 4,530 sonnets):

- `disco001g.xml` — Joseph Aragonés (Golden Age, 1 sonnet)
- `disco002g.xml` — Benito Arias Montano (Golden Age, 2 sonnets whose
  ids start at s002g_0002 — the sonnet-ordinal space is corpus-wide
  per author, never per-file-1-based)
- `disco002n.xml` — Isabel Esperanza Betancourt (19th c., 1 sonnet)

License: repo README verbatim "The corpus is available under: CC-BY
license."; the LICENSE file is CC-BY-4.0 → class attribution. The
met/rhyme/enjamb line attributes are AUTOMATIC (encodingDesc's own
words: ADSO scansion, RhymeTagger, ANJA) — carried as annotations,
labeled, never presented as gold.
